scope.summary: Create StudioModelAdapter (ModelAdapter trait, model-lane registry) + the typed Studio command API scaffold: command_id (studio.<domain>.<command>.v<N>), auto-generated input/outputSchema, dry_run, receipt, undo semantics, MCP tool exposure. Backend read surface over StudioDocument (tree/selectors/diff).
acceptance_criteria: StudioModelAdapter registered; command contract shape present; MCP read API live
expected_tests: test: command contract carries dry_run+receipt+undo; MCP inputSchema auto-generated
live: read API returns StudioDocument tree/diff

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No model-visible/steerable command surface; models cannot drive Studio.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
